name: background_2000
status: Pseudonymized and reviewed; see scope and limitations

provenance.source: Enron corpus (FERC 2003 release), 150 custodians, full parsed set

name_detection.note: the model tags and links names per email; it never generates a replacement and never sees the real->fake map

replacement.note: Deterministic replacement followed by 11 reviewed corrections across 10 emails. Replaying both steps produced byte-identical corpus and private map with a different PYTHONHASHSEED.

verification.model: gpt-6-sol (azure, preset gpt-6-sol, reasoning medium), reads the anonymized text with no knowledge of the pipeline

final_model_audit.review_outcome: No further person-name correction required among these flags under the scope below.
final_model_audit.scope: Person names and personal aliases; preserve familiar address terms, pets, fictional/religious references, organizations, venues, and locations.
final_model_audit.limitation: Review of detected flags is not a proof of complete de-identification. Dates, locations, organization references and some URLs remain; context may link back to public source mail.

known_gaps: This is benchmark pseudonymization, not a guarantee against linkage to the public source.
Model extraction and audit can miss names. Ordinary words, context, and partial organization replacements can create ambiguity.
Some organizations, locations, dates, web addresses, familiar address terms, pet names and artistic/religious references remain.
The secret search is one bounded episode from one model; its candidates are unconfirmed and no threads are removed.
Use the supplied casting pools and review name_consistent when reusing a person; 66 of 100 usable candidates pass that check.
private_do_not_publish: Name extraction/audit rows and response checkpoints

limitations: One model provides no cross-model consensus; candidates remain unconfirmed.
The complete thread index was scanned; only selected full email bodies were read. This is not an exhaustive audit of all content.
The 100-action investigation budget excludes index pages and model helper calls.
Native control-sample accuracy/false_positive metrics do not label these background findings.

replacements.why: cited as a kept-back letter by gpt-6-sol in the sweep and by claude-opus-5.5 and gemini-3.7-flash on the thread
replacements.anonymised: locally with scripts/replace_thread.py: the firm as Keystone, pseudonyms and domains from the release's reserve; people not linked to the private map
